scope: All frozen source groups/queries/metadata; all component normal forms and cross-split prompt hashes; stratified bounded surface replays; AI inspection is not human linguistic approval.

AI_screen.inspection_unit: first premise + complete query for all P0/P2/P3/P4/P5/P6 rows; P1 inspected computationally
AI_screen.status: no definite grammar error detected in bounded AI screen; marked P3 postverbal subjects and spatial-P4 position descriptions need native human naturalness judgments

limitations: No native human linguistic approval is claimed. Existing 252 rows cover 36 source contexts at n=4/8 and remain unannotated.
Closed parser shares suffix routines with renderer; independently specified 12 suffix fixtures mitigate but do not remove shared-system error risk.
Exact ID/order/text isolation excludes duplicate instances; all strict total-order chains are abstractly isomorphic by design. This is not distribution-free out-of-family generalization.
Endpoint n-1 distance is a latent graph distance, not a demonstrated lower bound on model computational reasoning depth. Degree-based endpoint shortcuts remain possible.
Language and presentation lengths/tokenization remain design confounds, and P4/P5 are multi-feature interventions.
Full training held-out evaluation has no explicit linguistic approval gate in current frozen training source. User must not bypass review via a raised max_calls.
